key_impacts: Citywide storm-surge flooding exceeded the 100-year floodplain by 53%.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy.
Two New Jersey refineries (Port Reading and Linden) were shut down, removing 26.3% of 1,170,200 BPD capacity.
Gas stations in New Jersey could not operate due to power outages.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to power outages.
